BodyAsJson.Title: The latest entry requirements for your holiday and return journey
BodyAsJson.Description: It’s your responsibility to ensure that you meet entry requirements for your holiday destination and for your return to the UK, which may change between booking and travel. Make sure you keep checking the FCDO page for your destination to find out the steps you need to follow - you'll also be able to sign up for email alerts should anything change.

BodyAsJson.Title: Discounted Covid-19 testing
BodyAsJson.Description: If you need a Covid-19 test to travel to your destination, we’ve been working with service providers to give you a couple of options. Typically you’ll need to have had the test carried out.

BodyAsJson.Title: Travel insurance to cover you for this trip
BodyAsJson.Description:
•  COVID-19 cover included for medical emergencies & cancellations
•  Personal property cover up to £2,500 with gadget cover available
•  Free cover for over 150 sports & activities
